limits: Checks the issue #1684 rule on the HTTP lane only: under --wait, a pipeline that is found with an empty status must be asked again rather than ending the wait. The stub listing answers the case's first status once and success afterwards; the bad case (empty first) must cost a second listing call and end green, the good case (success first) must end on the first look. The verdict is the stub's CALL COUNT plus the final FLOW_CI_STATUS, not the gate's exit code. Does not establish the woodpecker-cli lane (its empty-status and failed-relisting paths are in tests/test_flow_ci_status.py), the recorded-provider dispatcher in lib/cicd/flow.py (tests/test_flow_recorded_providers.py), the exit codes 2 and 5, the deadline itself (FLOW_CI_SLEEP=/bin/true, no clock is waited on), or that a real Woodpecker server ever lists a pipeline with an empty status - the incident's cause was read from the code, not reproduced. Anchor is the pre-change source at d79d0042a2daff328eb8c7f5607fdd7fe00d1b60; no network is used. These cases exercise backend evidence with CPP_FLOW_CI_BACKEND=probe.
